title: Frost Minion
summary: Frost Minions are birdlike creatures made of ice who serve Ymir, the king of the frost giants. Along with the Ice Creature Titans, Ymir is capable of summoning an army of these Titans to do battle.

sections.heading: History
sections.wikitext:
The Vikings believed in beings known as Frost Giants and their king named Aurgelmir, or [[Ymir]] for short. In Norse mythology, these Frost Giants fought alongside Ymir against Thor's father, Odin, before the creation of the world. Thor later had to fight off Ymir in order to protect the realm of Asgard while his father was in the Odin Sleep.

When [[Dante Vale]]'s team investigated the [[Temple of Thor]], Ymir was summoned by the [[Guardians of Thor]] to create an army of [[Ice Creature]]s and Frost Minions to deter the progress of the [[Huntik Foundation]]. The Frost Minions were defeated on the [[Rainbow Bridge]] by [[Ignatius]] with help from [[Montehue]] and [[Tersly]]'s [[Venadek]]. {{source|The Legacy of Thor}}

sections.heading: Abilities
sections.wikitext:
Though comparatively weak on their own, the Frost Minions' power lies in their numbers. Summoned by [[Ymir]], a whole army of Frost Minions may be created at once to overwhelm the opponent. The aerial Frost Minions tend to be invoked alongside the terrestrial [[Ice Creature]] Titans for almost complete coverage of the terrain.
